pilotDomainEndToEnd.why: the paired-axis shape, which is the one of the three that could not be expressed by copying work-orders: an inspection's result only exists once the inspection has happened, so the second axis is defined for every record and meaningful for a subset.
pilotDomainEndToEnd.leg1_registryEntry: src/domains/inspections.mjs exports INSPECTIONS_DOMAIN via defineDomain, which validates the descriptor at MODULE LOAD; src/domains.mjs imports it and appends it to DOMAIN_REGISTRY. A malformed descriptor never registers.
pilotDomainEndToEnd.leg2_declaredShape: recordShapeFor('mygov','inspection') resolves the variant attached in src/adapters.mjs. The bidirectional divergence test in src/fixtures.test.mjs proves the shape table and the registry agree in both directions: every registered domain resolves to a declared shape, and every declared shape is reachable from a registered domain.
pilotDomainEndToEnd.leg3_generation: generateInspectionRecords draws from mulberry32(seedFor('mygov:inspection')). seedFor is the pack-keyed factory; no clock and no Math.random is reachable, measured by the directory-derived source scan in src/domains.test.mjs which picked up the three new files because they exist.
pilotDomainEndToEnd.leg4_seamGuards: composeDomain runs assertRecordShape, assertNoRealWorldContent and assertDeclaredVocabulary over every returned record and assertNoRealWorldContent over extras. The generator calls none of them. Watched firing below.
